Elven Mask

Rules:

Classic Sudoku: Each digit 1-9 appears once in every row, column and 3x3 box.

Thermo: Digits on a thermometer must increase, starting from the grey circle.

Play: On a desktop, the link opens the puzzle in the Logic Wiz web app in your browser. On a phone, it opens the puzzle in the Logic Wiz mobile app. You can also solve it on paper from the picture.

https://link.sudoku.logic-wiz.com/4gRf

Enjoy solving!
solutionCode: Enter the digits in Row 1 from left to right
